title: Existing organization and company research pools, with entity-type guardrails
provenance: Counts from already published Power Atlas JSON plus an audit of the user's private Transparency/OpenLedger source code. No private database rows were retrieved.
distinctions: FEC committees, nonprofit recipients, donor individuals, lobbying clients and corporate companies are different entity types. Counts cannot be added as unique companies or assumed ownership relationships.

pools.name: Verified corporate and brand evidence graph
pools.unit: entities with typed metadata; includes brands, PE investors and 10 political-finance company candidates
pools.eligibility: Source-linked ownership edges only; company candidate nodes remain unresolved

pools.name: Transparency / OpenLedger researched cost mechanisms
pools.unit: research case studies, NOT seven proven causal pricing results

pools.name: Existing contractor/PAC company directory
pools.unit: corporate research candidates with public PAC and recipient identifiers
pools.eligibility: Research company candidates only, without parent-UEI attribution

pools.name: Original business influence cases
pools.eligibility: Original official-award and political giving sources, not proof of influence

pools.name: FEC committee master
pools.eligibility: ConnectedOrganization values are hints; many are other PACs, parties or committees; never classify as companies without matching legal identifiers

pools.name: IRS nonprofit grants
pools.unit: outbound IRS Schedule I recipient records, NOT donor-to-politician transfers
pools.eligibility: Only classify organizations from official EIN/name and disclosure; grant recipients are not necessarily for-profit

pools.name: Lobbying filing subset
pools.eligibility: Clients and registrants must be disambiguated; text matches do not prove policy outcome

pools.name: Public integrity investigation cases
pools.eligibility: Flow labels may be people, firms, government bodies or allegations; not a corporate-owner list

pools.name: Midterm political donor rankings
pools.eligibility: Some donors are people, PACs, unions and nonprofits. Do not treat them as companies or beneficial owners.

reusableConcepts: temporal entity graph with typed ownership edges
seven evidence-classified Price of Power cases
transparencySourceStatus.registryScope: The private OpenLedger code source lists two CERI companies (P&G and PepsiCo) and one seeded dated brand-ownership chain (MET-Rx). Its PostgreSQL historical records were not exposed by the GitHub file tree.
incomplete: Current live ownership share positions from 13F/13D/G not ingested into OpenLedger entity graph
Complete corporate subsidiaries from SEC 10-K Exhibit 21 not ingested
No direct database connection established to historical OpenLedger PostgreSQL 18k-row snapshot
No local store/provider roster or synchronized fee/price observations joined to identified owners
transparencySourceStatus.privacy: Only publicly sourced, reviewed case narratives and named issuer/investor relationships have been copied into the public Power Atlas. Private database content and proprietary code remain in the separate private project.

relationshipGates: Normalize legal entity IDs (CIK, EIN, UEI, LEI, state entity number) before claiming equivalence
Ownership/control requires documented source, effective date and scope; portfolio listing is not a 100% ownership claim
Keep PAC sponsor and federal contract recipient legally separate until researched
Only add local competitors after verifying branch/site ownership and municipality/district boundaries
Price effects require transparent numerator, denominator, period, valid comparator and local source
Different political contribution and procurement reporting periods must not be merged into causal ROI
